But several claims overreach or are inconsistent with the evidence, and the cited examples do not fit the narrative.","problems":["Headline and rationale say the excess 99215 share 'holds in every complexity tier', but the 0-condition tier is 4.1% vs 2.2% overall, and the 4-condition tier is 14.3% vs 11.7%. Excess is real but small in those tiers, and 'sicker panel does not explain it' is overstated given 99215 share rises steeply with complexity (72.7% at 5+).","z-score vs peers is only 1.11, which is not strong evidence of an outlier, yet the summary leans on upcoding without noting this weakness.","Claim that 'overall mix is unusually concentrated in 99214' is not supported by any peer comparison on the card (872 of 1,103 is about 79%, but no peer share given).","Cited examples are mismatched: two cited claims (C0212816, C0213724) are documented below-billed 99213/99214 claims that are not 99215 and do not support the 99215 argument, while the rationale text singles out URI and back-pain claims that are not among the cited claim IDs.","'Against 9% for comparison providers' compares 0 of 1 documented 99215 claims to peers; a sample of one is meaningless, and the summary treats it as informative.","Documented below-billed rates (10% for 99213, 5.3% for 99214) are above peers' rates, which is not discussed; the 1-of-14 lab-missing finding is labeled 'weak evidence' yet still used to support inflated documentation.","Missing-data flag is thin: only 2.7% of claims have records, which limits conclusions, though it is mentioned."]}
